Class validators

java.lang.Object
app.validation.validators
public final class validators extends Object
Utility class containing parsing and validation helpers for user input.

All methods are static and throw IllegalArgumentException when the input is missing or invalid, so callers can surface clear messages to the user.

  • Method Details

    • parseMoney

      public static BigDecimal parseMoney(String s)
      Parses a currency amount from a string.

      The value is trimmed, converted to a BigDecimal, ensured to be non-negative, and scaled to two decimal places using RoundingMode.HALF_UP.

      Parameters:
      s - the raw amount string entered by the user
      Returns:
      the parsed monetary value
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input is null, blank, non-numeric, or negative

    • parseDateFlexible

      public static LocalDate parseDateFlexible(String s)
      Parses a date from a flexible string format.

      The method extracts numeric year, month, and day components from the string, allowing various separators (e.g., 2024-10-31, 2024/10/31, 2024 10 31).

      Parameters:
      s - the raw date string
      Returns:
      the parsed LocalDate
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input is null, blank, missing parts, or cannot be converted into a valid date

    • parseStatus

      public static AssetStatus parseStatus(String s)
      Parses a status string into an AssetStatus, in a case-insensitive way.

      The string is trimmed and uppercased before lookup.

      Parameters:
      s - the raw status string
      Returns:
      the parsed AssetStatus
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input is null, blank, or does not match a valid status

    • parseBooleanLoose

      public static boolean parseBooleanLoose(String s)
      Parses a boolean value from a "loose" user-friendly string.

      Accepts common variants such as "y", "yes", "true" for true and "n", "no", "false" for false. A null or blank string is treated as false.

      Parameters:
      s - the raw boolean-like string
      Returns:
      true or false based on the interpreted value

    • parseInt

      public static int parseInt(String input)
      Parses an integer quantity from a string, enforcing a valid range.

      The value is trimmed, parsed as an integer, and validated to be between 1 and 999 inclusive.

      Parameters:
      input - the raw quantity string
      Returns:
      the parsed quantity
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input is not a number, or is outside the range 1–999
